description: Preview an inventory item creation WITHOUT creating anything (read-only). In hosts that render widgets (e.g. ChatGPT) this opens an editable confirm card: it lists the still-missing required fields, your user fixes values and fills gaps right on the card and hits 'Create item' there (the card itself calls create_item). Call it IMMEDIATELY once item creation is understood — partial prefills are valid; NEVER request missing fields in conversation before opening the card. Resolve references silently where unambiguous (categoryId via get_item_requirements, people/locations via search_resources) — do not turn reference resolution into a user interrogation either; if you could not resolve a category, preview anyway: the card then shows a category PICKER and your user chooses there. Returns the resolved proposal plus the applicable field definitions and which required fields are still missing. In hosts without widgets, confirm the proposal in the conversation and call create_item yourself as usual.

categoryId.description: Category id (resolve with get_item_requirements) — the created item will need one, so pass it when you know it; omit it and the card shows a category picker instead of asking you to interrogate the user

customFields.description: Proposed field values keyed by fieldDefId (from get_item_requirements) — same shape as create_item's customFields

homeLocationId.description: Home location resource id (find with search_resources); omit to use the org/category default

minStock.description: Optional restock threshold for quantity-tracked stock

name.description: Proposed item name — omit if not known yet; the card asks for it

quantity.description: Initial stock amount — required with trackingMode "quantity"

trackingMode.description: Pass "quantity" for quantity-tracked stock (consumables) instead of a serialized single item

name: preview_item_create
title: Preview item creation
